quests.title: A Starry Night, as Remembered

dialogue.t: Why are you up here yourself? There isn't even a rail line here, and it's way high up at the very edge of the Mirage.
People rarely come here. Even Idyia... Heh, I doubt she even knows this place exists.
So if there's nothing here, why are you here, Jeroney?
I just came out for a little fresh air... Hey, don't give me that "you ran away from home after arguing with Ferdinand again" look!
Come on, there really wasn't an argument. I'm just taking a stroll out of, well, I don't know, personal interest!
I suppose you already knew that the Choo-Choo Cart was my idea. At that time, I was only thinking: What's something that could easily reach great heights...
So I... So Jeroney brainstormed the Choo-Choo Cart and the rails, all for the love of the sky and heights.
Sounds silly, doesn't it? I remember Inazuma has a saying that goes something like, "only idiots and smoke like to rise up high"...

dialogue.sit: It's awesome that you could think up the Choo-Choo Cart.
I think it is so much fun.

dialogue.t: But it can only exist in the Veluriyam Mirage.
...Forget it, let's not talk about it. I also came here to stargaze.
I know the stars here are merely an ephemeral shadow from outside the Mirage, but they're pretty enough for me.
Every night when I look upon the starry sky... I feel so peaceful.

dialogue.sit: The one who loves the starry sky... is it Jeroney...?

dialogue.t: But whoever sees a starry sky like that couldn't help but fall in love with it. If only I could see the stars in the daytime...
Or even better, if I didn't have to climb up here every day!
Wait! That's possible! Paimon's got an idea!
Huh? Really?

dialogue.sit: We can just take a photo...

dialogue.t: Pho... Photo? That sounds like some advanced technology.
Yeah, why don't we take a photo of the starry sky for Jeroney?
Can you really do that?
But... Paimon isn't sure of any good spots to take pictures of the starry night...
Here! At night, on the platform here, you can see the most beautiful starscape! That's the reason I came here in the first place.
Really? Great! Jeroney, you just wait for our photo!
Photos... I can't believe something so amazing exists already. Now, it's possible to keep a record of all kinds of amazing scenery...
Well, {NICKNAME}, did you finish taking the photo? I'm really looking forward to seeing your photo of the starry sky!
Placeholder
Jeroney, we're back~! See, this is the photo! Check it out!
...Wow, it looks just like what my eyes would see.
Are you really giving me this photo?
Of course, we took it just for you!
Haha, thank you... thank you so much. I never thought I'd see such amazing technology. With technology like this, maybe one day we will also be able to build a Choo-Choo Cart outside the Mirage.
What a gorgeous night sky... If only we had technology like this back then, then... then he would have been able to see this beautiful sight whenever he wanted.

quests.description: Jeroney wishes to be able to see the starry sky whenever he wants, so why not take a photo of it for him? Even if it’s only the reflection inside the bottle and not the real thing, it will be beautiful enough.
